mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may increase allopurinol metabolism, potentially reducing allopurinol efficacy; additionally, allopurinol may increase eslicarbazepine levels through inhibition of metabolic pathways.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and eslicarbazepine concentrations; dosage adjustments of either drug may be necessary to maintain therapeutic efficacy.
